seo.title: Best Tea Houses in Amman (2026) | tabiji.ai
seo.metaDescription: Discover Amman's finest tea houses, from traditional Jordanian spots to modern tea bars. Find your perfect brew, serene ambiance, and local flavors in the heart of Jordan.

hero.subtitle: Amman offers a captivating tea scene, blending rich traditions with contemporary tastes. Whether you seek aromatic mint tea in a bustling souk or a specialty brew in a modern lounge, the city's tea houses provide a comforting escape and a taste of Jordanian hospitality.

picks.name: 1Wild Jordan Center Cafe
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Perched on the cliffs of Jabal Amman, the Wild Jordan Center Cafe offers breathtaking views of the old city while you savor your tea. It's a serene oasis serving traditional Jordanian mint tea and a selection of herbal infusions, often accompanied by local light bites. The rustic, eco-friendly ambiance makes it a perfect escape.
picks.whatToOrder: Fresh Mint Tea with a side of local pastries.
picks.insiderTip: Go just before sunset for truly spectacular views of the Amman cityscape as the lights come on.
picks.mapQuery: Wild Jordan Center Cafe, Othman Bin Affan Street 36, 1st Circle, Jabal Amman, Amman, Jordan

picks.name: 2Turtle Green Tea Bar
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Turtle Green Tea Bar is a modern haven for tea connoisseurs, offering an extensive menu of specialty loose-leaf teas from around the world. Their knowledgeable staff can guide you through various black, green, oolong, and herbal options. It's a chic, minimalist space perfect for a quiet afternoon or a healthy light meal.
picks.whatToOrder: Matcha Latte or a pot of their exquisite Darjeeling first flush.
picks.insiderTip: They also offer a great selection of healthy snacks and desserts that pair perfectly with their teas. Ask for a brewing recommendation based on your mood.
picks.mapQuery: Turtle Green Tea Bar, Rainbow Street, Jabal Amman, Amman, Jordan

picks.name: 3Sufra Restaurant
picks.whyItMadeTheList: While primarily a renowned restaurant, Sufra offers an exquisite tea experience in its stunning traditional setting. Located in a beautifully restored old villa on Rainbow Street, their courtyard is perfect for enjoying authentic Jordanian black tea or sahlab, often accompanied by delightful Arabic sweets. It's an immersion in elegance and heritage.
picks.whatToOrder: Traditional Jordanian Black Tea with a side of knefeh.
picks.insiderTip: Reserve a table in the garden or on the balcony during good weather. It's an ideal spot for a post-dinner tea or a luxurious afternoon break.

picks.name: 4Books@Cafe
picks.whyItMadeTheList: More than just a bookstore, Books@Cafe is a beloved cultural hub and a relaxed spot for tea. With a cozy indoor area lined with books and a popular outdoor terrace, it's perfect for unwinding. They offer a good range of standard teas, flavored options, and often have live music or events in the evenings.
picks.whatToOrder: Their classic English Breakfast Tea or a refreshing Iced Peach Tea.
picks.insiderTip: Find a quiet corner to read or head to the terrace for great people-watching. It's especially vibrant on weekend evenings.

picks.name: 5Shai wa Nana (Tea & Mint)
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Shai wa Nana, directly translating to 'Tea and Mint', is a quintessential local tea house experience in Amman's bustling downtown. It's unpretentious, vibrant, and serves tea the traditional way – strong, sweet, and often with plenty of fresh mint. Expect a lively atmosphere and a true taste of local life.
picks.whatToOrder: The house specialty, Shai wa Nana (Mint Tea).
picks.insiderTip: This is a great place to people-watch and soak in the downtown energy. Don't expect fancy decor; embrace the authentic, bustling ambiance.
picks.mapQuery: Shai wa Nana, Cairo St 21, Downtown, Amman, Jordan

picks.name: 6Jameeda House
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Jameeda House, known for its delectable Jordanian home cooking, also offers a warm and inviting setting for tea. Enjoy traditional hot beverages like sage tea or Turkish coffee after a hearty meal, or simply stop by for a comforting break. The decor reflects a cozy, traditional Jordanian home.
picks.whatToOrder: Sahlab (milk pudding drink) during colder months, or Sage Tea (Shai Maramiyya).
picks.insiderTip: They have outdoor seating in a charming courtyard which is lovely on a mild day. Pair your tea with one of their homemade desserts.
picks.mapQuery: Jameeda House, Sha'aban 9 St, Jabal Lweibdeh, Amman, Jordan

picks.name: 7Dabouq Tea Lounge
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Dabouq Tea Lounge offers a refined tea experience in a chic, contemporary setting. This dedicated tea lounge focuses on high-quality loose-leaf teas, served with elegance and attention to detail. It's a serene spot, perfect for quiet conversations, business meetings, or simply enjoying a sophisticated tea moment away from the city's hustle.
picks.whatToOrder: One of their premium green teas, or a carefully crafted tea latte.
picks.insiderTip: Ask about their seasonal tea selections or limited-edition blends for a unique tasting experience.
picks.mapQuery: Dabouq Tea Lounge, Dabouq, Amman, Jordan

picks.name: 8The Coffee Bean & Tea Leaf (Abdoun)
picks.whyItMadeTheList: While an international chain, The Coffee Bean & Tea Leaf offers a reliable and comfortable spot for a wide range of teas. Located in the modern Abdoun district, it's a great option for those seeking familiar choices, consistent quality, and a comfortable, air-conditioned environment. Their flavored teas and iced teas are popular choices.
picks.whatToOrder: Moroccan Mint Tea or an Iced Passion Fruit Tea.
picks.insiderTip: Utilize their comfortable seating for catching up on work or a relaxed chat. They have a loyalty program for frequent visitors.

picks.name: 9Fakhreldin Restaurant
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Fakhreldin is an upscale Lebanese restaurant that provides a sophisticated setting for enjoying traditional Middle Eastern tea. After indulging in their renowned cuisine, relax in their beautiful garden or elegant indoor space with a pot of aromatic tea. It's an experience of luxury and impeccable service.
picks.whatToOrder: Turkish Coffee or their house-blend Lebanese Mint Tea.
picks.insiderTip: Dress smart-casual. This is more of a destination for a full dining experience, but their post-meal tea service is a highlight not to be missed.

picks.name: 10Cafe Hanin
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Nestled on Rainbow Street, Cafe Hanin exudes local charm with its colorful decor and relaxed atmosphere. It's a popular spot for both locals and tourists to enjoy a cup of traditional tea or Turkish coffee, alongside shisha. The outdoor seating offers a lively street view, perfect for soaking in the local ambiance.
picks.whatToOrder: Hot Sweet Black Tea with fresh mint, often served in small glasses.
picks.insiderTip: Find a seat outdoors to enjoy the vibrant energy of Rainbow Street. It's a great spot for a casual break while exploring the area.

picks.name: 11Al Balad Theatre Cafe
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Part of the vibrant Al Balad Theatre cultural center, this cafe offers a unique blend of art, community, and good tea. It's a space where artists and intellectuals gather, providing a stimulating atmosphere. Their menu includes standard teas and often local herbal infusions, making it a great stop before or after a show.
picks.whatToOrder: Their simple black tea, or ask for the day's special herbal brew.
picks.insiderTip: Check their schedule for plays, workshops, or film screenings, and combine your tea visit with a cultural event.

picks.name: 12Majlisna Cafe
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Majlisna Cafe (meaning 'our gathering place') lives up to its name, offering a comfortable and stylish setting for social gatherings over tea and light bites. With contemporary decor and a relaxed ambiance, it's a popular choice in Abdoun for both casual meetings and quiet contemplation. Their tea selection is robust, including classic and flavored options.
picks.whatToOrder: A classic English Breakfast or a fragrant Jasmine Green Tea.
picks.insiderTip: They have comfortable lounge-style seating, making it ideal for longer stays or group discussions. Their dessert menu is also worth exploring.

faq.question: What kind of tea is most popular in Amman?
faq.answer: The most popular tea in Amman is undoubtedly black tea, often served strong and sweet, typically with fresh mint (Shai B'Nana or Shai Maramiyya if with sage). Turkish coffee is also extremely prevalent, but for actual tea, the mint-infused black tea is a cultural staple, often enjoyed at any time of day.

faq.question: Are there tea ceremonies in Amman similar to those in Japan or China?
faq.answer: While Amman doesn't traditionally have formal, intricate tea ceremonies like those in East Asia, the act of preparing and sharing tea is deeply embedded in Jordanian hospitality. It's often served as a welcoming gesture, and the ritual of making and pouring tea for guests is a cherished cultural practice, focusing on connection and conversation rather than formal steps.

faq.question: What's the best neighborhood in Amman for finding good tea houses?
faq.answer: Jabal Amman, particularly around Rainbow Street and the 1st Circle, is a fantastic neighborhood for diverse tea experiences, ranging from traditional cafes to upscale restaurants with excellent tea service. Downtown Amman also offers very authentic, budget-friendly local tea houses, perfect for a genuine local experience.

faq.question: Do tea houses in Amman typically serve food?
faq.answer: Many tea houses and cafes in Amman do serve food, ranging from light snacks and pastries to full meals. Traditional tea houses might offer local sweets or mana'eesh (flatbreads), while modern tea bars often pair their brews with healthy snacks, sandwiches, or desserts. Always check the menu, but it's common to find food options.

faq.question: Is it customary to tip at tea houses in Amman?
faq.answer: Tipping is customary in Amman, and it's appreciated at tea houses. A tip of 5-10% of the total bill is generally considered appropriate if you are satisfied with the service. For smaller bills, rounding up to the nearest convenient amount or leaving a few extra dinars is also common practice.

faq.question: Can I find specialty or international teas in Amman?
faq.answer: Yes, Amman's tea scene has diversified significantly. While traditional Jordanian teas are ubiquitous, you can find dedicated specialty tea bars like Turtle Green Tea Bar or Dabouq Tea Lounge that offer a wide selection of international loose-leaf teas, including various black, green, oolong, white, and herbal infusions from around the globe.

methodology: Our selection of Amman's best tea houses was curated through extensive research, local recommendations, and analysis of online reviews. We prioritized venues offering diverse tea selections, unique ambiances, excellent service, and a true reflection of Amman's vibrant tea culture, ensuring a mix of traditional and modern experiences.
